name: PT Indomobil Sukses Internasional Tbk
summary: PT Indomobil Sukses Internasional Tbk engages in the integrated automotive business in Indonesia. The company operates through Automotive, Financial Services, Car Rental and Logistics, and Others segments. It distributes vehicles and spare parts, as well as fuel, assembles vehicles, manufactures automotive parts/components, and provides after-sales services, vehicle financing, car rental, used car trading, logistics, non-formal education services, and other related supporting services, as well as acts as a trademark license holder.
